persons.name: Viśvaratna
persons.evidence: liṣitaṃ taṃrāchitola jhvābāhārayā varjācāryya viśvaratnaṃ coyā thaota dayakā tayā juro

date.as_written: samvat 1021 mti phārguna śukla pūrṇṇemā ṣunaṃ

purpose: svārtha: scribe wrote it and made/kept it for himself (coyā thaota dayakā tayā); book not to be given/lent to others, on pain of the guru's curse (guru doha lāyu)
notes: Newari colophon. 'varjācāryya' = vajrācārya. 'taṃrāchitola jhvābāhārayā' gives the scribe's quarter (ṭola) and bāhāl, not an explicit place of copying; Jhvā Bāhāl is a Buddhist monastery of the Valley (identification Patan vs. Kathmandu not certain, so normalized left empty). Date agrees with catalogue (NS 1021 = c. Feb/Mar 1901). 'ṅeya eṃkāpisaṃ pacaya yāya madu' is an injunction against others taking/lending the book; standard scribal disclaimer follows.
